channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: At least three dead in Idaho shopping mall mass shooting
item.description: Police said at least three people were killed several others were wounded in a shooting at an In-N-Out Burger in Idaho.

item.title: Trump cancels Iran strike, says ‘deal perimeters’ reached
item.description: The US president announced that he has cancelled a planned military strike on Iran, claiming progress in talks.

item.title: Israel kills eight in Gaza despite Trump’s Hamas disarmament plan
item.description: Strikes hit Gaza homes after the US unveiled plans for Hamas disarmament and Israeli withdrawal.

item.title: US embassies issue alerts after Trump vows to hit Iran ‘hard’
item.description: US embassies in the Middle East are bracing for possible escalation after Trump said the US will hit Iran 'hard'.

item.title: Hungary plans to shut down only nuclear power plant amid drought
item.description: Officials say they must shut down nation's sole nuclear plant as record-low Danube water levels disrupt reactor cooling.

item.title: Iran war live: Trump cancels attack, calls for a ‘rapid’ deal on Hormuz
item.description: Move comes after Iran's top diplomat warned of a 'decisive response' to any US-Israeli 'aggression'.

item.title: Michigan joins Minnesota in reporting cyberattacks, with FBI investigating
item.description: No culprit has been identified in any of the attacks, which comes after authorities warned of possible Iranian plot.

item.title: Peruvian plane crash kills 13, including European tourists
item.description: Those killed include 11 passengers and two pilots flying over the famous archaeological site, recognised by UNESCO.

item.title: Record-breaking climber Nirmal Purja among those killed in avalanche
item.description: 14 Peaks star Nirmal Purja has died in an avalanche while leading 10 climbers up Broad Peak mountain in Pakistan.

item.title: Trump says he is cancelling strikes on Iran subject to deal being made 'rapidly'
item.description: The US president claims Iran and other Middle Eastern countries asked Washington to hold off on any attack as the "perimeters" of a deal had been agreed.
